The song "Hum Chhod Chale Hain Mehfil Ko" is a poignant and heartfelt track from the Bollywood movie Ji Chahta Hai (1964). It is sung by the legendary playback singer Mukesh, whose deeply emotive voice beautifully conveys the sorrowful and introspective mood of the song.
